Game Overview

Small Viking puts players into a fun experience centered on navigate treacherous dungeons as a fearless small Viking, battling monstrous foes and dodging deadly traps. With charming visuals and a thrilling soundtrack, each of the 100 levels challenges your reflexes and wits. Outsmart enemies, avoid pitfalls, and unravel puzzles in a fast-paced arcade adventure. Can you survive till the end?
